payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute Fibonacci numbers up to 1000, then set array positions to 'O' for Fibonacci indices, 'o' otherwise. No search algorithm used.
payload.rationale: Solution directly constructs answer via precomputation. No search, backtracking, or enumeration. None of the complete_search subtypes fit. Chose search_backtracking arbitrarily; mismatch is total.
